snippet:
arXiv:2608.28599v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Clinical diagnosis is a step-by-step, cost-aware process: a physician orders examinations one at a time, observes the results, and updates the diagnosis before reaching a final conclusion. We model diagnosis as a cost-aware sequential decision process and train the policy with reinforcement learning.
